firstPlayerRule: Check these fantasy events in order: alien abduction, pirate press-ganging, a vampire bite, dragon burns, a princess's kiss, Cthulhu-induced madness, a teddy-bear attack, or being eaten by an orc. The most recent match to the first applicable event starts.
officialTieBreak: If none of the events applies, the group decides who starts.
clarifications: These are the comprehensive rulebook's playful criteria, in priority order.
The separate formal faction-drafting procedure chooses its first drafter randomly.
